target.quadraticModel: Y(omega)=G_loss+i omega alpha G plus calibrated fixtures and declared higher-order residuals
target.freeFitParameters: one positive global capacitance scale alpha, a frequency-independent dissipative matrix if statistically resolved, and independently calibrated fixture parameters; no entrywise refit of G

reconstruction.calibration: subtract open, short and through fixture standards with their covariance retained
reconstruction.singlePortTomography: each complex single-port drive estimates one full admittance column; symmetrize only after testing reciprocity
reconstruction.capacitanceExtraction: joint generalized least squares fit of Im Y(omega)/omega to alpha G over all seven frequencies
reconstruction.covariance: retain the full real-imaginary, cross-port and cross-frequency covariance; propagate it through alpha fitting, eigendecomposition and matrix inversion by parametric bootstrap
reconstruction.heldOutPrediction: predict all 24 complex currents for twelve preregistered Rademacher multiport voltages per frequency without refitting

proposedPassGates.pass: inside the preregistered calibration covariance envelope
at most 0.001 at every frequency and statistically consistent with the retained covariance
proposedPassGates.failMeaning: nonreciprocity, port-map error or unmodelled active coupling

proposedPassGates.metric: minimum eigenvalue of Hermitian Re Y
proposedPassGates.pass: not below minus three propagated standard errors at any frequency
proposedPassGates.failMeaning: calibration failure or an active/nonpassive element outside the declared model

proposedPassGates.pass: at most 0.001 throughout the commissioning band
proposedPassGates.failMeaning: loss invalidates the ideal reactive-network approximation

proposedPassGates.metric: maximum pairwise spectral-norm change of Im Y/omega after one global scale
proposedPassGates.failMeaning: frequency-dependent parasitic modes invalidate a static capacitance matrix

proposedPassGates.pass: positive by at least five propagated standard errors
proposedPassGates.failMeaning: singular or incorrectly de-embedded quadratic network

proposedPassGates.pass: at most 0.01 with the bootstrap 95 percent upper limit also at most 0.01
proposedPassGates.failMeaning: the implemented quadratic form lacks Leech provenance at the global 24-mode scope

proposedPassGates.metric: covariance-weighted prediction error on 84 held-out multiport configurations
proposedPassGates.pass: global chi-square p value between 0.01 and 0.99 and worst relative spectral response error at most 0.01
proposedPassGates.failMeaning: the fitted matrix does not predict superposed multiport response

decisionTree.allPass: commissioned quadratic Leech-metric candidate; proceed to nonlinear pendulum gap, strip edge and inversion-branch-cut tests
decisionTree.inverseOnlyFails: retune signed mixing coefficients or choose another Pareto basis; do not claim Leech provenance
decisionTree.dispersionFails: enlarge the admittance model to include explicit parasitic poles and repeat on a held-out frequency set
decisionTree.reciprocityOrPassivityFails: reject the passive-transformer model before any topological interpretation
decisionTree.heldOutFails: reject overfit or incomplete matrix reconstruction

epistemicBoundary.passClaims: the measured linear network realizes the selected Leech quadratic metric within the declared frequency band and uncertainty
epistemicBoundary.passDoesNotClaim: a bulk gap, 24 chiral edge modes, rootlessness, inversion orbifold, Moonshine spectrum, Monster defects or Griess closure

established: a finite 252-configuration, 25200-acquisition protocol can accept or reject the complete 24-port quadratic Leech metric with reciprocity, passivity, dispersion and held-out prediction controls
boundary: Numerical thresholds are preregistered proposed engineering gates, not universal constants. Instrument bandwidth, fixture geometry, absolute frequency scale and achievable covariance must be supplied by the selected platform.
